title: Roadmap Steward Operational Cadence v1 — Rig Relay
description: Defines the recurring operational rhythm for the Roadmap Steward. All outputs are content-light structured JSON/JONL artifacts. No mutation is performed at any cadence point.

cadence_points.name: morning_roadmap_scan
cadence_points.frequency: daily, on operator invocation or cron trigger (e.g. 0800 UTC)
actions: read HEAD commit and branch from git log -1
read git status --porcelain (path hashes only)
read all active lane declarations from coordination store
read latest test collection report (test_infrastructure_import_stabilization_v2.v1.json)
read all release gate artifacts (mcp_hardened_read_only_surface_release_gate, cli_governance_gate)
read schema validation results (scripts/rig_relay_validate_schemas.py output)
read latest receipt manifest counts and content-light classifications
compare active lane file ownership against dirty state
detect lane collisions (shared files, shared schemas, incompatible sequencing)
emit morning briefing: docs/json/governance/roadmap_steward_morning_briefing_v1.v1.json

cadence_points.name: after_final_report_rescore
cadence_points.frequency: on detection of new final report artifact in docs/json/governance/
actions: read the new final report artifact
re-score all candidate slices with updated roadmap state
re-rank recommendation queue
emit updated recommendations: roading_steward_initial_recommendations_v1.v1.json
detect whether the completed slice resolves any blocker

cadence_points.name: evening_briefing
cadence_points.frequency: daily, on operator invocation or cron trigger (e.g. 1800 UTC)
actions: summarize day's outcomes from final reports created since last evening briefing
count receipts produced (from receipt manifest enrichment data)
list new risks surfaced in final reports
list slices completed vs deferred
emit evening briefing: docs/json/governance/roadmap_steward_evening_briefing_v1.v1.json
emit next-action queue for next worker session

cadence_points.name: idle_session_assignment
cadence_points.frequency: on operator request: 'what should I work on next?'
actions: return top-ranked ready-to-grab slice with bounded prompt
include: exact files, validation command, acceptance criteria, dependency impact, blast radius, stop conditions
emit assigned prompt: docs/json/governance/roadmap_steward_next_action_queue_v1.v1.json

cadence_points.name: emergency_blocker_escalation
cadence_points.frequency: triggered by stop conditions (gate failure, test breakage, schema failure, collision)
actions: identify the blocker: gate name, affected files, last good state
recommend immediate pause on all lanes touching affected files
emit escalation: docs/json/governance/roadmap_steward_blocker_escalation_v1.v1.json

cadence_points.name: weekly_convergence_review
actions: review all lanes active during the week
detect lanes that stalled (> 3 days without new final report)
detect lanes producing excessive receipts without slice completion
detect lanes touching files outside their declared scope
recommend park/defer for stalled lanes
emit weekly review: docs/json/governance/roadmap_steward_weekly_review_v1.v1.json

integration_notes.pi_harness: Each cadence point can be triggered by a cron entry or a /slash command. Output artifacts are written to .build/rig-relay/steward/ and optionally pushed to a notification channel (email, Signal, WhatsApp) via a read-only notification adapter.
integration_notes.local_agent: Same cadence. Outputs to .build/rig-relay/steward/. No network access needed. Notifications handled by operator's existing tooling.
integration_notes.prompt_handoff: When a slice is assigned, the steward produces a bounded prompt artifact that an OpenCode/Codex/Rig worker can consume directly. The prompt includes file paths, validation command, acceptance criteria, and explicit stop conditions.
